dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Heh, doubtless, the city is more festive.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: The heroes we commemorate during Lantern Rite are actually adepti who lived in Liyue in the distant past.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Do you know which adeptus the Mingxiao Lantern commemorates this year?

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I asked around for information, and a gentleman who looked very knowledgeable told me that the adeptus' name is Menogias, also known as General Kapisas.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I've heard that although he was most famous for being a deadly yaksha warrior, he was also well-versed in clothing design and tailoring.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: An adeptus of artistry, sounds like! I'm sure he will bless us with novelty!
